text: 9月11日，沪深两市全天成交额合计19718.98亿元。其中，沪市成交额为9581.86亿元；深市成交额为10137.12亿元；创业板成交额为4626.15亿元。
text_en: On September 11, the combined daily turnover of the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets totaled 1,971.898 billion yuan. Of this, the Shanghai market turnover was 958.186 billion yuan; the Shenzhen market turnover was 1,013.712 billion yuan; and the ChiNext turnover was 462.615 billion yuan.
